answer: Make each identity earn its place by completing a unique, peer-checked task that cannot be copied or reused, such as labelling a fresh dataset whose answers are verified against hidden ground truth. Each task takes roughly twenty minutes of real work, so one fake costs twenty minutes, ten cost two hundred, and a thousand cost twenty thousand minutes. A plume of new identities cannot simply appear on the ledge; every quill must first do its own work, and reused or copied work is rejected, so cost grows linearly with every fake.
